ai-orch-dev-foundations.courseBlurb: Specify requirements, give an AI coding tool the context it needs, and decide when to take over.

ai-orch-dev-reading-code.courseBlurb: Read unfamiliar code for intent, control flow, data shapes and dependency cost, and use tests as a reading tool.

ai-orch-dev-review.courseBlurb: Review AI-generated code for common bugs, injection, auth and secrets, concurrency, and error handling.

ai-orch-dev-agentic.courseBlurb: Break work into steps an agent can finish, scope what it may touch, and check each step of a run.

ai-orch-dev-shipping.courseBlurb: Write tests that can fail, prepare changes for review, work with CI, and deploy changes you can undo.

ai-orch-dev-practice.courseTitle: Scoping and Accountability for AI-Assisted Work
ai-orch-dev-practice.courseBlurb: Estimate and scope AI-assisted work, understand disclosure and accountability, and apply it all in one capstone change.

ai-workflow-seeing-process.courseBlurb: Map a process as it actually runs, ask people the right questions, and measure a baseline before changing anything.

ai-workflow-foundations.courseBlurb: Diagnose where AI belongs in a process, choose between rules, models and people, and name the risk early.

ai-workflow-tool-selection.courseBlurb: Choose tools on evidence, specify the pipeline, treat prompts as tested components, and fit the work into existing systems.

ai-workflow-client-consulting.courseBlurb: Scope and price an engagement, set expectations early, explain AI plainly, work with the people affected, and close cleanly.

ai-workflow-validation-roi.courseBlurb: Check accuracy independently, monitor for drift after launch, calculate ROI honestly, and know when to recommend less automation.

ai-workflow-practice.courseBlurb: Position your work, read contract terms that matter, decide which engagements to refuse, and keep up with change.

accessibility-qa-lived-experience-founda.courseBlurb: Learn what accessibility QA produces, how WCAG and the law apply, and what automated testing can and cannot find.

accessibility-qa-lived-experience-assist.courseBlurb: Test with a keyboard, a screen reader, magnification, switch access and voice control, and read the accessibility tree.

accessibility-qa-lived-experience-cognit.courseBlurb: Find cognitive, language, sensory and interaction-cost barriers, including design that is accessible yet coercive or undignified.

accessibility-qa-lived-experience-audit-.courseBlurb: Scope an audit, capture evidence, rate severity, write a report developers can act on, and retest fixes.

accessibility-qa-lived-experience-advoca.courseBlurb: Understand why correct findings go unfixed, work with design and engineering, make the case internally, and build accessibility into process.

accessibility-qa-lived-experience-career.courseTitle: Credentials, Sustainable Practice and Staying Current
accessibility-qa-lived-experience-career.courseBlurb: Compare accessibility credentials, structure sustainable practice, and keep up with WCAG and assistive technology changes.
